summary: DevOps engineer with experience building CI/CD, containerization and deployment automation. I set up build, test and deploy pipelines on GitHub Actions and Gitea Actions, package services with Docker, and deploy applications behind nginx with systemd and automated HTTPS. I administer Linux servers and set up DNS, directory services, monitoring and backups. Coming from development (C#/.NET, Unity), I see the full cycle — from code and tests to release and operations.

bullets: Set up CI for the Unity project SurvMine on GitHub Actions: build, ~40 unit tests and a performance report
Automated WebGL template builds and build-report generation in the monetization SDK
Built backend auto-deploy through GitHub Actions over SSH with a dedicated deploy key
Defined build and test pipelines (NUnit, pytest) for several projects

work.company: VK Mini Apps production backend: deployment and operations
bullets: Deployed the service as nginx → systemd → Kestrel (127.0.0.1:8000) → SQLite
Configured a systemd unit with Restart=always, running as an unprivileged user and logging to journald
Set up HTTPS via certbot and Let's Encrypt, with separate nginx access/error logs
Wrote the server bootstrap script: packages, directories, env file, API access
Set up auto-deploy via GitHub Actions and SQLite storage in WAL mode

work.company: Git server and CI/CD on Gitea
bullets: Deployed Gitea on Ubuntu Server with repository, user and access-right management
Set up CI/CD on Gitea Actions: act_runner, Docker, automated build, tests and deploy
Ensured security: mandatory GPG commit signing, secret-leak scanning, audit
Set up Nginx as a reverse proxy, BIND9 (forward/reverse zones) and OpenLDAP for authentication
Collected development metrics (DORA) and deployed services on Oracle VirtualBox
Defined a Docker Compose service stack: Portainer, File Browser, Home Assistant, Navidrome, Gitea
Set up Caddy as a single source of routing (reverse proxy)
Set up local DNS and CI/CD on Gitea Actions
Maintain a Minecraft server control panel with an RCON console
